usedFor: Podio holds your work items and Calendly makes booking links, so “New Item Created” can feed “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Item Created” in Podio, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: Each new item in a Podio app gets its own booking link when it is added.

watchOut: “New Item Created” is polling, so “Create Scheduling Link” runs after a scheduled check.
